svg.text: Arabic isolated from the shared articulatory field — inherited phonology stabilized by recitation, grammar, script, and authority.
the emphatic axis — tafkhīm ط ض ص ظ
Tajwīd recognizes 17 sub-positions (makhārij khāṣṣa) within 5 main areas (ʿāmma).
Several IPA columns share one makhraj; the emphatic ط ض ص ظ carry tafkhīm.
